main_measure.name: drift-adjusted, position-weighted next-bar return of the short (mean per case)
main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t-stat >= 2.0 to confirm; <= 0 with t-stat <= 0 to reject

supporting_check.name: largest-third minus smallest-third (by |position|) mean drift-adjusted next-bar drop

decided_by: Reject rule: the short earns 0 or less after the drift adjustment, with a t-stat of 0 or below.
reading: A case is a bar labelled regime 'mean_reversion' with a next bar in the same window. Its value is postRebalance_current_allocation x (next-bar return minus that window's unconditional mean next-bar return), and cases with a zero position count with value 0. The t-stat is the mean over its standard error, pooled over all windows. Thirds come from a stable sort by |position|.
